rows.en: (Ahh~ I can't wait for Sheryl's concert.)

\p-san,
what's got you so giddy?
Oh, Luca... It's Sheryl's concert, you know?

The Galactic Fairy is coming,
and you're not excited, Luca?

Well, I'm taking part in it
in my EX-Gear, so...
rows.notes: Luca performs in the EX-Gear aerial show at Sheryl's concert, as in the anime.

rows.en: Oh, right. I'm so jealous.

It's not as great as it sounds...
The pressure's giving me a stomachache...

That may be true,
but I'm still jealous.

If you're coming to the concert,
please cheer for us too.
Yeah, of course!
Well then, I have practice, so...

(Getting to be part of the concert, huh...
I'm so jealous.)
(Ahh~ I can't wait for Sheryl's concert.)
Oh, Luca-kun... It's Sheryl's concert, you know?

The Galactic Fairy is coming,
and you're not excited, Luca-kun?

That may be true,
but I'm still jealous... *sigh*...

(Everyone in town seems to have calmed down...
I guess having a destination really
makes a difference.)

Who's that over there...?
Hey, Luca!
Looks like they've finally found a new planet.
Yeah. I wonder what kind of planet it is.

They've found one, but
whether we can reach it is another question...
Is it gonna be tough?

I suppose so...
The worries never end, but we have to do it!
Yeah, let's do our best!
Well, I'll be heading home.
(A new planet, huh...)

(Everyone in town seems to have calmed down...
I guess having a destination really
makes a difference.)

Who's that over there...?
Hey, Luca-kun!
Yeah. I wonder what kind of planet it is?
Is it gonna be tough?

(...I'm hungry.
Maybe I'll go buy a late-night snack.)

\p-san,
what are you doing out at this hour?
Oh, you came to the convenience store too, Luca?
Yes. I was so focused, I forgot about dinner...
What were you up to...?
...That's a trade secret...
Anyway, you sure get hungry this late, huh.

You do... At this hour, don't you get a crazy
craving for stuff that's bad for you?
I sure do. I was gonna buy some cup ramen myself.

I'm going to buy some cup yakisoba and head home.
See you at school.
(...Cup yakisoba sounds pretty tempting too.)

Oh, you came to the convenience store too,
Luca-kun?
What were you up to...?
Anyway, you sure get hungry this late, huh~
I sure do. I was gonna buy some cup ramen myself.
(...Cup yakisoba sounds pretty tempting too!)
(...Even this place got wrecked...)
rows.notes: Passive as in the Japanese; the attacker is not named in the scene.

rows.en:
\p-san,
what are you doing here?

I could ask you the same thing.
What are you doing here, Luca?

I came to check how bad the damage is.
This is our town, after all.
Something like this must never happen again...

...I'm going back now.
\p-san, please don't stay
out here too long either.
(...I'll head home too.)

I could ask you the same thing.
What are you doing here, Luca-kun?
(...I'll head home too.)
(The tests are finally over...)

\p-san,
you look pretty worn out.

Once the tests were over,
I kind of ran out of steam.
How did they go?
...I did everything I could.
I hope you get good results.
They were a breeze for you, right, Luca?
Hahaha... Not really...

In that case, why don't we stop somewhere
on the way home to unwind?
Let's go to Nyan-Nyan! Your treat, Luca!

Wha-- Hey, wait!
That's not happening~
(Today I'm eating with Luca!)
(The tests are finally over...)
...I did everything I could, but...
They were a breeze for you, right, Luca-kun?
Let's go to Nyan-Nyan! Your treat, Luca-kun!
(Today I'm eating with Luca-kun!)

uncertain: c17685/c17687: 'they've found' - the subject of mitsukatta is impersonal (the fleet's leadership); 'they' kept vague; Luca then says 'we' for reaching it.
c17713: 'Even this place got wrecked' - passive kept; who wrecked it (the Vajra attack) is not said in the scene.
